label: Orazio Melzi
summary: Son and heir of Francesco Melzi, from whom Pompeo Leoni obtained the bulk of Leonardo's papers.

value.text: Heir of the Leonardo papers at Vaprio after c.1570

claims.statement: After Francesco Melzi's death (c.1570) the papers passed to his son Orazio; Leoni obtained most of them from him (c.1580 per the Royal Collection; c.1582 to 1590 in its provenance line).

sources.cite: Royal Collection Trust, The Leoni binding (RCIN 933320 page). Seen in a web search result summary only; the page was not opened in this session.

open_questions: Orazio Melzi's dates were not found in this round.
